ask.en: Put the stages of making black tea in order.
ask.kk: Қара шай өндіру кезеңдерін ретімен қойыңыз.

why.en: Sequencers: First → Next → After that → Once → Finally.
why.kk: Реттілік сөздері: First → Next → After that → Once → Finally.
why.ru: Связки последовательности: First → Next → After that → Once → Finally.

items: First, the top leaves and bud are picked by hand.
Next, the leaves are withered on racks for 12–18 hours.
After that, they are rolled by machine.
Once they have oxidised and turned brown, they are dried in hot air.
Finally, the tea is sorted, graded and packed.

why.en: A cyclical process returns to the start. Say so in the overview: ‘a cyclical process’.
why.kk: Циклдік үдеріс басына қайтады. Overview-да солай жазамыз: «a cyclical process».
why.ru: Цикличный возвращается к началу. В overview так и пишем: «a cyclical process».

items.text: The life cycle of a honeybee
Making river water safe to drink

ask.kk: Ара тіршілік циклі. Ең жақсы overview:

why.en: Number of stages + start and end of the cycle, without small figures.
why.kk: Кезең саны + циклдің басы мен соңы, ұсақ сандарсыз.
why.ru: Число этапов + начало и конец цикла, без мелких цифр.

options: Overall, there are six stages, from an egg being laid to the adult bee collecting nectar, and the adult emerges on day 21.
Overall, the queen lays up to 1,500 eggs a day, and each egg hatches after three days in a wax cell.
Overall, bees are very important insects because they make honey and help farmers to grow more food.
Overall, the larva is fed by worker bees for six days, and then the cell is sealed with wax by them.
